title: Simone Mendes and Kaká Diniz: Recent Statements Heat Up Searches
seoTitle: Simone Mendes and Kaká Diniz: Recent Statements Heat Up.
subtitle: The sertaneja singer and the businessman share details of 14 years of marriage and life together, generating huge public interest.
excerpt: Simone Mendes' recent remarks about her marriage to Kaká Diniz, including a birthday tribute and revelations about the couple's intimacy, spark widespread curiosity.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Sertaneja singer Simone Mendes has become one of the most searched names, driven by recent public statements about her marriage and intimacy with businessman Kaká Diniz. The remarks include a birthday tribute and detailed interviews about the dynamics of their 14‑year relationship.

Celebrating 14 Years of Union

This Friday (the 28th), Simone Mendes posted a love declaration for Kaká Diniz, who turned 41. The artist celebrated 14 years together, recalling how they met and how quickly they married. She also highlighted the arrival of their children, Henry and Zaya, who, according to her, gave a new meaning to the couple’s love.

Simone expressed deep admiration for Kaká, describing him as a man who built his own story with courage and hard work. She emphasized her husband’s generosity, his ability to care, love, and make people feel important. The tribute ended with wishes that God fulfill Kaká’s dreams, grant him health and wisdom to lead the family.

Opening Up About the Couple’s Intimacy

Recently, Simone Mendes and Kaká Diniz also addressed the public’s curiosity about their marriage, discussing details of their intimate life. In an interview with Quem, Kaká Diniz commented on the couple’s concern about not crossing limits when sharing their life, but affirmed that what they talk about is what they actually live.

On another occasion, on Wednesday (the 26th), during an interview with reporter Maria Rita from the LeoDias portal in Barretos, Simone Mendes humorously spoke about how to keep the “flame of union alive” after more than a decade. She joked with the reporter when asked about the couple’s “pique.”

Love as a Decision and Relationship Frequency

Businessman Kaká Diniz and Simone Mendes shared their perspectives on love. Kaká said, “Love is a decision. People think love is only a feeling.” Simone added, describing marriage as the daily decision to love, kiss, hug, and say affectionate words.

When asked about the frequency of the couple’s sex life, Kaká Diniz declared, “It has to happen weekly, if not daily. It’s not daily because she runs away.” The artist responded by explaining that their work trips are the reason. Simone is mother to Henry, 12, and Zaya, 5.

The Overwhelming Start and Jealousy

Simone Mendes recalled the beginning of her relationship with Kaká Diniz. She said she married the businessman after only 45 days of dating, explaining the speed of the union. “When I was single I dated a lot, but only with kisses. A beautiful train like this, would you think it would take long?” the singer joked.

Regarding jealousy, Simone Mendes assured, “Nothing, I’m super chill, girl. Totally relaxed.” Kaká Diniz confirmed his wife’s calmness, reiterating that she “is indeed very relaxed.”

Information sourced from Globo, NaTelinha, Terra.
